other_conditions: Applicant must not be a defaulter under any scheme of DSFDC, Nationalized Bank, Financial Institution, or Co‑operative Bank
Applicant must possess knowledge and experience as required by the scheme
Applicant must obtain required permissions such as SSI Certificate or Pollution Control Certificate where applicable
For manufacturing units, the workplace must be in an approved industrial area
Target groups include Minorities, Safai Karamcharis, and Persons with Disabilities
Income ceiling for SC, OBC and Minority categories is ₹1,20,000 per annum (₹6,00,000 for the creamy layer of Minority); no income limit for Persons with Disabilities and Safai Karamcharis
benefits_summary: Term loan up to ₹5,00,000 with repayment over 60 months (ten years for persons with disabilities) and a short moratorium period.
